body: Two Rust crates both understand envelopes and neither talks to the other: vibe_core::canonical recognises vmls1 and only FLAGS it (Prepared.sealed_elsewhere), vibe_secure::session is what actually opens it. Swift (VibeKeychainKeyUnwrapper/VibeSecureSessions) is the sole bridge. That unwrapper is batched, keyed by message id and retry-tolerant — the wrong shape for MLS: process_message MUTATES the ratchet, is order-sensitive, must not be replayed. This mismatch is why open() needed a pending-commit merge and an envelope-suffix plaintext key. If Rust is to own decryption, the unwrapper contract must become ordered-per-group and single-shot.
